---
applyTo: '**'
---
1.Before writing any new file go through the repo to find related files and try to follow the same method to have consistency
2. Keep the code base small and avoid rewrtiting large chunks of code. Focus on small incremental changes.
3. Use your brain to understand which function can be reutilized instead of creating a new one.
4. Write comments only when necessary to explain why something is done, not what is being done.
5. Follow the existing code style and conventions used in the project.
6. Go through the folder structure and naming conventions used in the repo to create new files and folders accordingly.
